limitations.text: No imagery could be retrieved: imagery_window returned 'not_allowed: this task has no imagery source' for both gsi-seamless-aerial-japan and sentinel-2-l2a-cogs. No candidate was visually verified; existence and warehouse-vs-factory/market/hangar distinction are unconfirmed. Embedding index is synthetic (aef-10m-annual fixture, 160 m cells, 3430 cells) so cells are about warehouse-sized and do not resolve single buildings. Few-shot retrieval used 16 PLATEAU building training examples (not specifically warehouses), top 60 cells returned; 25 cells at score>=0.8 aggregated into 24 mostly single-cell sites. Remaining cells were not reviewed. Count range: low 6 (score>=0.87), high 24; true count not established, candidates unvalidated. Only the top candidate was recorded as a cannot_assess claim. Stopping because no further evidence source is available.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses/large logistics buildings (>=~1600 m2) in AOI 136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N (Nagoya port area, Japan), 2024, as points with confidence and count range.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings coarse for building-level distinction
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x7.8 km. Use embeddings to shortlist candidates, then verify with aerial imagery windows.
